[CBSE Class XII History, marking scheme, 2023-24]
28. “The Mahabharata is an invaluable source available to historians to 8
study social practices and norms in early societies”, Justify the CB
statement.
Answer-
 Mahabharata a dynamic epic-contains vivid descriptions of battles,
forests, palaces & settlements.
 Its growth was not hindered by its language.
 Over the centuries it has been written in many languages of the world.
 It depicts an on-going dialogue between the people & communities on
the one hand and the authors on the other hand.
 It incorporated many stories that originated in different regions.
 Main story of the epic was often retold in different ways.
 Many episodes of this text had been depicted in sculptures and
pain
